tpose.text: Please stand on the two black feet marks and make a t-pose for few seconds.

marker_start.text: Lock your hands in front of your body to start recording.

marker_end.text: Recording. Lock your hands in front of your body to stop recording

signal_text.text:
During your performances, try to always stay with your feet on the two black feet indicated on the board.

After a meaning is displayed, you will have time to think about what you're gonna do. However, do not think about it too much and go with your intuition.

When you are ready, you need to make a signal in order to start the recording. To do so, lock your hands in front of your body. You will see red text on the screen when the recording starts.

signal_guesser.text: Your partner have some time to think about what they will do. When they lock their hands in front of their body, it means that they are ready to start to perform. When they are done, they lock their hands again.

marker_demo.text: Recording. Lock your hands in front of your body to stop recording.

proceed_enter.text: Confirm your input by pressing enter

welcome_text_g.text:
Welcome in the experiment that investigates how well you can communicate without a language. This is part one.

As in any communication, there are two roles: performer and guesser. Performer’s task is to express a meaning. The guesser has to guess the meaning as accurate as possible. You now start as a guesser.

In total, there will be three conditions for the performer:

 1) In condition ‘Gesture’ - you can only use gestures of your upper body
2) In condition ‘Vocal’ - you can only use sounds of your mouth and voice
3) In condition ‘Multimodal’, you must use both gestures and sounds.

In each condition, you will be introduced to the rules, then one of you starts as a performer and the other as a guesser, and then you turn your roles.
In total, each of you will express 30 meanings.

If you have any questions now, do not hesitate to ask the experimenter in the room.

Do you have any questions?

If not, get ready and let's start the experiment!
